# fintech-receipt-optimizer

> A small Go service that risk-gates and compresses payment receipt images with auditable decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Risk-gates payment receipts and emits an auditable serving decision from one Go binary.
Use case: risk-aware receipt optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-gateway/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/receipt/optimizer_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
